title: Reference approach: Linear Equation Solver
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Accept a coefficient matrix and right-hand-side vector.
Validate shapes and solve with numpy.linalg.
Calculate residuals and use allclose with a justified tolerance.
Report rank or conditioning caveats where relevant.
explanation: Solve and evaluate small systems of linear equations with numerical checks. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
